outcome: Pregnancy loss (miscarriage, stillbirth/intrauterine death, medical termination of pregnancy, ectopic pregnancy)
cohort: 718 pregnant women with hypothyroidism at the Aga Khan University Hospital
finding: In a cohort of hypothyroid pregnancies, postpartum hemorrhage and emergency cesarean section were frequent, with preconception and third-trimester TSH levels above 2.5 mIU/L associated with these adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with preconception TSH levels > 2.5 mIU/L, while postpartum hemorrhage was significantly associated with TSH levels > 2.5 mIU/L in both the preconception and third trimester.
